name: SEO Setup
description: Turns a validated .seo/profile.json into a running SEO agent: prepares the workspace, connects and tests Search Console, SerpApi (Google Trends), Gmail, Outlook or Slack, Google Slides, GitHub or Jira, creates the journal and the action tracker, then schedules only what the profile's features ask for (alert check-up, improvement pass, article writer, claude:fix task) as cloud tasks and runs each once.
